comment: Seeded bugs of the ties pass. Each was planted, made the named check fail, and was restored (lake build of the named module, or python3 tools/trust_map.py --check exit 1 and the named test). L*: a tied declaration changed, so the theorem that ties it fails to prove. T*: the side-table tie or the statement dump broken.
